correctness.rationale: Direct open-neighborhood criterion yields optimal P3 family; all allowable one-edge moves are ac, ub, uc after deleting ab, of which exactly ac and ub are slides. Center rotations plus isolate-to-any-label exchanges prove slide connectedness for all q. The canonical group action gives transitivity and handshake counts. Exhaustive n=4,7 and direct canonical n=10,13,16 checks independently pass.
